title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 13: the prophets who speak out of their own heart, the whitewashed wall, and the women who hunt souls.

questions.text: Against whom was the prophet told to prophesy?
questions.explanation: He was told to prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy out of their own heart.

questions.text: What were Israel's prophets compared to?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, 'Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.'

questions.text: What had these prophets failed to do for the house of Israel?
questions.explanation: They had not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in Yahweh's day.

answers.text: Go up into the gaps and build up the wall
Read the law aloud to the people
Warn the king of the coming sword

questions.text: In which writing would the prophets who see false visions not be written?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says they will not be in the council of his people, nor written in the writing of the house of Israel, nor enter the land of Israel.

answers.text: The writing of the house of Israel

questions.text: What do they do when someone builds up a wall?
questions.explanation: Because they have seduced the people saying 'Peace' where there is no peace, when one builds a wall they plaster it with whitewash.

answers.text: They tear it down to the ground
They measure it with a line
They set a watchman on it

questions.text: What would come against the plastered wall?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says there will be an overflowing shower, great hailstones will fall, and a stormy wind will tear it.

answers.text: Thick darkness, smoke and a rushing fire
An overflowing shower, hailstones and a stormy wind
Locusts, famine and a wasting pestilence
An earthquake and a flood from the river

questions.text: What would be uncovered when Yahweh breaks down the wall?
questions.explanation: He will break down the wall and bring it to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered.

questions.text: What did the women who prophesy out of their own heart sew?
questions.explanation: Yahweh pronounces woe to the women who sew pillows on all elbows and make kerchiefs for the head, to hunt souls.

questions.text: For what had they profaned Yahweh among his people?
questions.explanation: They had profaned him among his people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, lying to people who listen to lies.

answers.text: Pieces of silver and vessels of gold
Handfuls of barley and pieces of bread
Skins of wine and jars of oil
Honor among the princes of Israel

questions.text: What would they no longer do at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says they will no more see false visions nor practice divination, and he will deliver his people out of their hand.

answers.text: See false visions or practice divination
Live in the land of Israel
Speak to the women of the city
